test_title: SSC CGL Tier-II (AAO) 2023 Official Paper-III (Held On: 27 Oct, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In relation to Production Possibilities Curve (PPC), which of the following statements is INCORRECT ?

options.text: The slope of the Production Possibility Curve at any given point is called marginal rate of transformation.
The Production Possibilities Curve is also called production possibility frontier.
The Production Possibilities Curve always slopes upwards from left to right.
Production Possibilities Curve is concave to the origin because marginal rate of transformation goes on increasing.

solution:
The correct answer is **The Production Possibilities Curve always slopes upwards from left to right.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Production Possibilities Curve always slopes upwards from left to right:**

 
 
• This statement is incorrect. The Production Possibilities Curve (PPC) typically slopes downwards from left to right, reflecting the trade-off between the production of two goods. As more of one good is produced, less of the other can be produced due to limited resources.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **The slope of the Production Possibility Curve at any given point is called marginal rate of transformation:**

 
 
• This statement is correct. The marginal rate of transformation (MRT) represents the rate at which one good must be sacrificed to produce an additional unit of another good, indicating the opportunity cost.
 
 
 
• **The Production Possibilities Curve is also called production possibility frontier:**
 
 
• This is correct. The Production Possibility Frontier (PPF) is another term for the PPC, illustrating the maximum feasible amount of two commodities that a business can produce with available resources and technology.
 
 
 
• **Production Possibilities Curve is concave to the origin because marginal rate of transformation goes on increasing:**
 
 
• This is accurate. The PPC is typically concave to the origin because resources are not perfectly adaptable for the production of both goods, leading to increasing opportunity costs as production shifts from one good to the other.
